groups.name: platform.component.vector.connections
groups.description: Named physical connections used by the multi-store topology. Each entry is identified by a connection id; the provider-specific settings remain opaque to core and are strictly validated by the matching provider factory.

groups.name: platform.component.vector.stores
groups.description: Named logical vector stores. Business code routes by this stable id, not by provider type or Spring bean name.

groups.name: platform.component.vector.stores.<vectorStoreId>.query-defaults
groups.description: Optional Store-level query defaults. Null or empty fields inherit provider and core defaults. Applied with precedence: Core < Provider < Store < request.

groups.name: platform.component.vector.stores.<vectorStoreId>.indexes
groups.description: Logical indexes bound to the Store. Each entry is identified by an index id and is mapped to a physical collection/table/class by the active provider factory.

properties.name: platform.component.vector.connections.<connectionId>.provider
properties.description: Provider type for the connection (e.g. milvus, weaviate, qdrant, redis, postgresql, mongodb, neo4j, vikingdb). One connection maps to one provider.

properties.name: platform.component.vector.connections.<connectionId>.settings
properties.description: Provider-owned opaque settings. The matching provider factory is the single authority for key allow-listing and type validation; core preserves them as data.

properties.name: platform.component.vector.stores.<vectorStoreId>.connection-ref
properties.description: Reference to a connection id declared under platform.component.vector.connections.

properties.name: platform.component.vector.stores.<vectorStoreId>.embedding-model-ref
properties.description: Spring bean name of the EmbeddingModel for this Store. Use a distinct model per Store to avoid cross-Store vector-space contamination.

properties.name: platform.component.vector.stores.<vectorStoreId>.embedding-normalization
properties.description: Normalization contract the bound EmbeddingModel guarantees. Affects retrieval accuracy and Provider-side index compatibility checks.

properties.name: platform.component.vector.stores.<vectorStoreId>.embedding-modalities
properties.description: Modalities supported by the bound EmbeddingModel. Used for capability discovery and Store description; not used to silently coerce data.

properties.name: platform.component.vector.stores.<vectorStoreId>.default-index
properties.description: Logical index id bound to this Store. Must be declared in the same Store's indexes map.

properties.name: platform.component.vector.stores.<vectorStoreId>.required
properties.description: If true, Store startup failure blocks the application. If false, the Store is optional and a startup failure degrades the Store to DOWN without affecting the rest of the topology.

properties.name: platform.component.vector.stores.<vectorStoreId>.required-capabilities
properties.description: Provider-neutral capability ids the active provider must prove at startup (e.g. NATIVE_FILTER, ACL_FILTER, ACL_SAFE_HYBRID, QUERY_TUNING, INDEX_LIFECYCLE). See VectorCapability.

properties.name: platform.component.vector.stores.<vectorStoreId>.query-defaults.top-k
properties.description: Default topK for Store-bound searches. Inherits when null.

properties.name: platform.component.vector.stores.<vectorStoreId>.query-defaults.min-score
properties.description: Default minScore for Store-bound searches. Meaning depends on the Store's declared score threshold kind (NORMALIZED_RELEVANCE or PROVIDER_RAW).

properties.name: platform.component.vector.stores.<vectorStoreId>.query-defaults.candidate-limit
properties.description: Default number of candidates recalled from the Provider before framework-side diversification. Must be >= topK.

properties.name: platform.component.vector.stores.<vectorStoreId>.query-defaults.timeout
properties.description: Default per-search timeout enforced by the framework execution guard.

properties.name: platform.component.vector.stores.<vectorStoreId>.query-defaults.consistency
properties.description: Default consistency preference. PROVIDER_DEFAULT delegates to the active provider; other values may be rejected by individual provider adapters.

properties.name: platform.component.vector.stores.<vectorStoreId>.query-defaults.return-fields
properties.description: Default logical return field names. Provider-bound; not all providers honor projection.

properties.name: platform.component.vector.stores.<vectorStoreId>.indexes.<indexId>.name
properties.description: Physical index/collection/table/class name. Validated by the active provider factory; physical identity is bound to the Store, never accepted from a regular request.

properties.name: platform.component.vector.stores.<vectorStoreId>.indexes.<indexId>.dimension
properties.description: Vector dimension. Must match the bound EmbeddingModel; mismatches are rejected at Store creation.

properties.name: platform.component.vector.stores.<vectorStoreId>.indexes.<indexId>.metric
properties.description: Distance metric. Provider-specific values (cosine, euclidean/l2, dot/ip, ...). The chosen metric drives the score semantics declaration.

properties.name: platform.component.vector.stores.<vectorStoreId>.indexes.<indexId>.index-type
properties.description: Index algorithm (hnsw, ivf, flat, ...). Provider-specific.

properties.name: platform.component.vector.stores.<vectorStoreId>.indexes.<indexId>.replicas
properties.description: Replica count. Many providers do not apply this from the vector adapter; in that case the validator forces the value to 1.

properties.name: platform.component.vector.stores.<vectorStoreId>.indexes.<indexId>.shards
properties.description: Shard count. Many providers do not apply this from the vector adapter; in that case the validator forces the value to 1.
